Warehouse Worker with Forklift License 
 Samenvatting 
We are looking for experienced forklift operators for logistics and warehouse roles in Noord-Holland. The position includes forklift operation, loading and unloading goods, order picking, packing, and general warehouse tasks. Candidates should have forklift experience and basic English or Dutch skills. Omschrijving 
 - operating a forklift truck (loading and unloading goods) - warehouse work (picking, packing, and replenishment) - simple production or assembly tasks - internal transport and organization of goods within the warehouse 
 Over de opdrachtgever 
You will be working for reliable and growing logistics companies in Noord-Holland, offering stable employment, organized warehouses, and a professional work atmosphere. Eisen 
 - experience in operating a forklift truck - communicative level of English (or Dutch) - experience in logistics or warehouse work - driving licence (category B) is an advantage 
 Wat wij bieden 
 - hourly rate approx. €15.40-€15.84 - overtime and weekend bonuses - accommodation, transport to work, and health insurance - weekly payment system - legal Dutch employment contract.

Are you passionate about Identity and Access Management (IAM) solutions? Do you have excellent skills in Dutch and English? If so, we have an exciting opportunity for you!

Identity-Team B.V., a leading consulting firm specializing in IAM solutions, is seeking a highly skilled Identity Consultant to join our dynamic team. As an Identity Consultant, you will play a crucial role in delivering top-notch IAM services to our clients.

Tasks

- Collaborate with clients to understand their IAM requirements and develop tailored solutions using ForgeRock.

- Implement and configure IAM solutions based on industry best practices.

- Provide expertise and guidance throughout the entire project lifecycle.

- Conduct workshops and training sessions to educate clients on IAM principles and best practices.

- Occasionally travel to client sites to provide on-site support and consulting services.

Requirements

- Fluency in Dutch and English, both spoken and written.

- Strong knowledge and experience with ForgeRock/Ping Identity IAM solutions.

- Proven track record in delivering successful IAM projects.

- Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.

- Ability to communicate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

- Strong client-facing and interpersonal skills.

- Willingness to travel occasionally.

If you are a self-motivated professional seeking a challenging role in the dynamic field of IAM consulting, we would love to hear from you. Join our team at Identity-Team and take your career to new heights!

Mechanical engineer 

Description
• You prepare equipment specifications for pressure vessels, heat exchangers, pumps, etc.
• You recalculate pressure-retaining equipment according to construction codes such as AD2000 and ASME VIII.
• As an Equipment Engineer, you are familiar with the standards related to the above-mentioned activities.
• You are knowledgeable about applicable directives such as PED, ATEX, and the Machinery Directive.
• Your responsibilities also include inspections and monitoring the fabrication of equipment
• Evaluating M.O.C.
• Assistance of the M&P design team
• Maintain a good business relationship with our Manufacturers
• Performing and Evaluating calculations per ASME / EN / API
• Supervision of Engineering Contractors

Profile
• You hold a degree in Industrial Engineering (Bsc or Msc in Mechanical engineering.
• You have a minimum of 3 years of experience, preferably with chemical installations in an engineering environment.
• You show initiative and a sense of responsibility. 
• You are dynamic, precise, and have a keen eye for detail.
• As you frequently interact with clients, you possess strong communication skills.
• Required language skills: Dutch and English; German and/or French are an asset.

Relocations package:
As soon as we know that a highly skilled migrant will be joining us, Relocations schedules a Teams meeting. During this call, we talk through your preferences for housing, transport, and other practical matters. We’ll also explain the process, the required documents, and the allowances provided by Nouvall. Housing From the first meeting onwards, we help you step by step to find suitable housing. We’ll try to schedule an appointment with the local municipality as soon as possible so you can register and get your BSN (social security number). 
We’ll also help you with practical matters such as opening a bank account, applying for health insurance, and arranging contracts for your utilities. To help you settle in, we’ll arrange Dutch language lessons so you can start learning the basics quickly.

Job description Electrical engineer
• Develops a range of electrical engineering deliverables, including specifications, calculations, reports, technical requisitions, material requisitions and others.
• Administer the packages of the electrical engineering group.
• Uses technical knowledge to perform engineering assignments and produce a range of electrical engineering deliverables (including more complex tasks) with limited guidance and direction from more senior technical professionals.
• Ensure that Electrical Engineering activities are executed according to the project procedures, specifications and standards, good engineering practices and techniques, and any project-specific requirements.

• Must have the capacity to supervise and manage EPC Contractors and development of detail design deliverables.
• Must have proven ability to contribute during development of electrical system studies.
• Fluent English is a must, knowledge of French or German and Dutch is a plus.
• Experienced in the use of appropriate codes of practice, standards and relevant sections of statutory documentation.

Production Employee 5-Shift System Zevenaar

As a production employee in a 5-shift system in Zevenaar, you will work in a dynamic environment where no days are the same.

In this role, you are responsible for ensuring the smooth running of the production process. You start your day with a brief handover from the previous shift, after which you operate and check the machines. Throughout the day, you monitor the quality of the products and resolve any issues. You ensure that the products are packed and prepared for shipment.

You will be working at a leading manufacturing company in Zevenaar. The organization is known for its innovative approach and strong focus on quality. With a team of committed employees, they strive to deliver the best products. The work atmosphere is informal and focused on collaboration, with plenty of room for personal development. 

Requirements

- MBO/ vocational working and thinking level
- Experience in a production environment
- Forklift and reach truck certificate is a plus
- Team-oriented collaboration
- Good communication skills
- Problem-solving ability
- Knowledge of safety regulations
- Good command of Dutch or English

- Salary €17.50 per hour excluding shift allowance
- Full-time employment
- Working in a 5-shift system
- Travel allowance
- Holiday pay

A project on paper is one thing. Making sure it actually works? That’s a whole different story.

For an international player in automation and intralogistics, we are looking for a Project Manager to manage complex projects from A to Z.

You bring together technology, people, planning and budgets, making sure everything comes together at the right time. From kick-off to final delivery, you keep the overview and step in whenever adjustments are needed.

International projects, a lot of responsibility, and technology that you literally see in motion.

Functieomschrijving
 
• You manage international projects within robotics and industrial automation from A to Z, from kick-off to final delivery. 
• You set up and closely monitor project schedules, budgets and deadlines, making adjustments where needed to ensure successful project delivery. 
• You monitor the project’s quality, scope and risks and proactively anticipate potential changes or challenges throughout the execution. 
• You ensure strong collaboration and transparent communication with customers, suppliers and internal stakeholders, while leading meetings and project reporting.
 
• You have at least 5 years of experience as a Project Manager, preferably within a technical or industrial environment. 
• You are a strong communicator, hands-on and independent, and you enjoy taking ownership of your projects and results. 
• You are fluent in English; knowledge of French and/or German is a plus. 
• You are willing to travel internationally approximately 20% of the time.

In this role, you will ensure the precise finishing of aluminium profiles and frames. You will alternate between series production ans custom-made pieces, with quality always being the top priority. You'll receive a salary starting at €17.50 per hour, depending on your experience, supplemented by meal vouchers.

•

Do you already have experience as a metalworker or do you already have knowledge of an ERP system ? This is definitely a plus!

•

Our client is a specialized consultancy company with a unique market position, having worked exclusively with the same international aviation industry leader for more than 15 years. This long-term partnership offers an exceptional combination of stability, expertise, and continuous technological evolution.

Operating within a highly international environment, the company supports business-critical data and analytics initiatives that enable strategic and operational decision-making across multiple regions and business functions. Thanks to its close relationship with its client, employees benefit from the scale, complexity, and career opportunities of a large multinational organization while enjoying the agility, accessibility, and human-sized culture of a smaller consultancy structure.

As a Data Engineer / BI Consultant, you will contribute to the design, development, maintenance, and optimization of the organization's data ecosystem.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Developing, maintaining, and optimizing data pipelines within a Snowflake environment.
• Working with SQL and Linux/Bash to support data integration, automation, and transformation processes.
• Implementing and maintaining solutions within a modern Data Mesh architecture combining Data Lake and Data Warehouse principles.
• Ensuring the reliability, scalability, and performance of data flows and reporting solutions.
• Collaborating closely with international business stakeholders located across multiple countries and time zones.
• Gathering business requirements and translating them into sustainable and efficient data solutions.
• Supporting the continuous improvement of reporting, analytics, and Business Intelligence capabilities.
• Contributing to data quality, governance, and optimization initiatives.
• Participating in ongoing projects related to cloud data platforms and digital transformation.

The ideal candidate combines strong technical expertise with excellent communication skills and enjoys working in an international environment.

We are looking for someone who can demonstrate:

• 3 to 5 years of relevant experience in Data Engineering, Business Intelligence, Data Warehousing, or a similar domain.
• Hands-on experience with Snowflake at an intermediate level.
• Strong knowledge of:
• SQL
• Linux/Bash
• Data Factory
• Experience working with business stakeholders and translating functional requirements into technical solutions.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• The ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with international teams.
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management capabilities.
The following skills would be considered an advantage:

• Experience with Data Mesh architectures.
• Knowledge of Power BI.
• Experience with Matillion.
• Experience with Teradata.
Languages:

• English is mandatory.
• French and/or Dutch are considered strong assets.

Your Job as a Cross Contamination Compliance Engineer

Do you enjoy combining quality compliance with technical risk management in a pharmaceutical production environment? As a Cross Contamination Compliance Engineer, you will play a key role in maintaining and strengthening the cross contamination strategy at a leading API manufacturing site in Geel. You will work closely with operations and multiple departments to identify, assess, and mitigate contamination risks. Your expertise will help ensure sustainable compliance and support safe manufacturing processes. This is a visible role with a direct impact on quality, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.

Fortunately, we can count on you for:

 
• Maintaining and reviewing cross contamination risk assessments
 
• Ensuring contamination risks remain controlled during MoC activities
 
• Preparing, facilitating, and documenting cross contamination FMEAs
 
• Supporting operations during complex quality incidents and investigations
 
• Identifying improvement opportunities within contamination control processes
 
• Collaborating with multidisciplinary teams across manufacturing and quality
 
• Contributing to the site's contamination control strategy and compliance goals

You communicate clearly with different stakeholders and know how to build strong working relationships. You approach challenges in a structured way and can balance quality requirements with operational realities. You enjoy coordinating activities and bringing people together around a common objective.

What do you bring?

 
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Chemical Engineering, Process Technology, Chemistry, Bioengineering or equivalent experience
 
• Minimum 3 years of experience in a pharmaceutical or industrial manufacturing environment
 
• Knowledge of GMP, change management, FMEA, and risk assessment methodologies
 
• Understanding of cross contamination risks and contamination control principles; Annex 1 knowledge is an asset
 
• Fluent in English; Dutch is considered a strong asset

jobs.description:
As an Inside Sales Representative, you are responsible for providing excellent service and commercial support to customers in a specific region: Middle East, Africa and Eastern Europe. You work hand in hand with the External Sales Representative and help strengthen customer relationships, drive sales growth, and promote the use of our digital tools. 

Key responsibilities:
 
 

• Open new customer accounts (approx. 30%) and grow business with existing customers (approx. 70%) 

• Prepare accurate offers and price calculations 

• Enter and follow up on orders 

• Actively manage your accounts via phone and email, with a focus on cross-selling and digital migration 

• Maintain and update customer data in the internal system 

• Understand customer needs, market context, product applications, and competitors 

• Be the main point of contact for customer inquiries, complaints, and support 

• Identify and close commercial opportunities 

• Report on sales projects and progress in close collaboration with External Sales 

• Contribute to the team with flexibility and a hands-on attitude 
 

• You have a technical and/or commercial background 

• You have at least 4 years of B2B sales experience, preferably with technical products 

• You are fluent in English (spoken and written) – mandatory 

• Polish, Czech or another Eastern European language is a strong asset 

• French and/or Arabic is an asset 

• Strong skills in Excel and general IT tools 

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills 

• You are proactive, persuasive, structured, and a true team player 

• Able to multitask and work under pressure in a small but ambitious team

jobs.description:
Company located in Roeselare.

Jobomschrijving

What will you do as a Packaging Operator in the Food Industry?
	
• Operate, set up and monitor packaging and weighing machines	
• Check the quality and correct weight of packaged products	
• Identify and resolve minor malfunctions or report them in a timely manner	
• Perform quality control checks, including metal detection tests	
• Help maintain a clean, safe and organized working environment

	
• Experience as an operator or with packaging machines is an advantage, but not required	
• You work accurately and have a strong eye for quality	
• You speak Dutch, French, or English	
• A forklift certificate is a plus	
• You are willing to work in a chilled environment (5°C to 10°C)	
• You are willing to work in shifts (6:00 AM to 2:00 PM, 2:00 PM to 10:00 PM, or 10:00 PM to 6:00 AM)
